player_prompt.intro:
Wɔde Tower of Hanoi a ɛwɔ {num_disks} akɛsewa.
Wopɛ sɛ wobɛsan akɛsewa no fri tower A kɔ tower C.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosan akɛsewa, kae nkyɛn tower ne nkyɛn tower a wopɛ sɛ wosan no kɔ (e.g., '[A C]').
Hwee, wuhu sɛ wosan akɛsewa a ɛwɔ nkyɛn no, na akɛsewa a ɛwɔ nsamu no ankɔ so akɛsewa a ɛwɔ nsamu.
Baabi a wɔbɛsan, san nnyɛn biako.
